about: U4 permission catalog (our-setup flight plan). deny lands in user settings; ask is empty, since nothing asks Briggsy (2026-10-27: the history-wiping pushes are denied, U4 D3 as the cut changed it); projects lists the tracked project-file edits; playwright is the per-tool allow list the writer puts in place of a run-code allow that no deny covers (none at the landing: run-code is denied on every Playwright server); softDeny is the autoMode.soft_deny entry; marketplace turns auto-update on for every-marketplace, where CE comes from, since nothing is frozen (2026-10-27: Briggsy wants updates; U4 D7's freeze is lifted, and the matcher rows that expected it to deny a CE update now expect no rule); matcherTable is what Q17 expects the CLI to decide; pushSamples are the spellings matchesPush tests an allow against. Public: it names none of the rules the user settings hold today (the generator finds those at run time) and holds no private text.

softDeny: Destructive git pushes to a repository's default branch (main or master), in any repository and from either shell, however they are spelled: --force or -f (combined short flags such as -fu included), --force-with-lease, a +refspec, a :main delete or --delete, --mirror and --prune, including through git -C <dir>, git -c <key>=<value>, a quoted 'push', bash -c, PowerShell or a script. Literal deny rules in permissions.deny block the common spellings before the classifier sees them (U4, 2026-10-27); this entry covers every other spelling.
